import asyncio


async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    # Each chunk owns one barrier.
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):  # One chunk per pass.
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:  # Join this group.
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:  # Fill this group.
                # The group owns each operation.
                group.create_task(operation(item))  # Register each operation.


async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        # A comment cannot hide extra work.

        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )

        await operation(items[offset])
